answer: Each agent registers a TPM/SGX enclave key and submits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, device identity, and a nonce to the quill state tree; the ripple hash anchor and ocean consensus contract reject reused measurements. Forging an identity requires compromising distinct hardware or producing a valid enclave quote, while admission bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, making Sybil capacity require continuously provisioned silicon and superlinear capital.
